newsitem.title: VIETNAM: Vietnam, NZ rail container venture gets under way.
newsitem.headline: Vietnam, NZ rail container venture gets under way.

text.p: Vietnam's first railway container scheme, a $5.1 million joint venture with New Zealand Railways and McConnell International, has begun operation, the official Vietnam News Agency said on Friday.
It said the Vietnam Union of Railways had contributed 40 percent of the investment for the 20-year Vietnam-Minzr Railway Joint Venture, and the New Zealand companies 60 percent.
The agency said last year that in its first phase, the joint venture would operate between the northern port of Haiphong and the suburbs of Hanoi, with a capacity of 35,000 tonnes by 1997.
